declarations.not_r1: THIS IS NOT R1.  R1 is the v4.1.0 WP02 curve this project never ran (retrospective projection).  This file is a T08 continuation of WP420-02: set supervision on the A1 safe sets, measured on the development split.  No R1 quantity exists here.
declarations.single_seed: one training seed (0) and one initialisation (A0).  Nothing here says what seed 1 or another initialisation would do.
declarations.n20_no_interval: n = 20 dev episodes per ruler (1000-1019), 40 per arm.  No confidence interval is reported and none may be inferred from these counts: a 1/40 clear rate is a description of these 40 episodes, not an estimate of a rate.
declarations.old_instrument_cannot_report_a_clear: tools/rl/v410_student_eval.py OR the v400 evaluator cannot report stage_clear at all: cand_to_mask ORs BTN_SHOOT into every frame, so no SHOOT rising edge ever reaches the engine and an end-of-stage wait can never be left (T08 CLEAR_REACHABILITY.md).  Therefore every pre-T08 '0/20' / '0/80' number is a measurement of an instrument that could not report a clear, and NO old number is comparable with the numbers below.
declarations.new_instrument: tools/rl/v420_eval_shoot.py is the only evaluator that can report stage_clear: it releases SHOOT for exactly one frame every 48 decisions. Its positive control replays a recorded teacher tape to stage_clear=true / 13,195 frames / 2,631,430, and its negative control (same tape, period 1,000,000,007 = never release) reproduces stage_clear=false / game_over.  The two controls differ only in the period, so the clear is caused by the pulse.
declarations.labels_not_capability: A1 labels are set membership measured under A0's own continuation at H=120 on A0's TRAIN trajectories (seeds 3042-3091).  They localise failure; they are not a dev or generalisation corpus.
declarations.no_second_factor: no reward change, no budget change, no PPO coefficient change, no gamma/tau/lr/temperature change, no 1M/5M run.  The only difference from A0 is the supervised target: the safe set instead of one chosen action.

split.by: state (each state is a whole sample; no state is split)
split.ancestor_policy: ancestor-disjoint (a holdout state's seed never trains)
split.rule: ancestor split: every state of seed s goes to holdout iff s % 5 == 4, else to train

loss.diagnostic: L_unsafe = -log (1 - sum_{a not in S} pi(a|s))
loss.algebraic_note: 1 - sum_{a not in S} pi = sum_{a in S} pi, so L_unsafe must equal L_set up to float rounding; it is kept as a numerical cross-check through the complement and never enters backward()
loss.differs_from_a0_how: A0/A0v minimise -log pi(a*|s) on one chosen action per slot; this minimises -log sum_{a in S} pi(a|s), which leaves every choice inside S at full probability
loss.gradient: dL_set/dz_a = p_a - p_a/P * 1[a in S] with P = sum_{a in S} p_a: the target is the softmax renormalised inside S, so the model is pushed onto the set and stays indifferent inside it (|S| = 1 collapses to the ordinary CE)

protocol.target: the engine-verified A1 safe set S (2..17 members)
protocol.protocol_source: the T04 A0 protocol (seed 0 / 5,000 steps / batch 128 / Adam lr 1e-4 / wd 0 / clip 0.5 / cuda / strict determinism), unchanged

uniform_reference.definition: the L_set of a policy that spreads probability uniformly over all 18 candidates, -log(mean |S| / 18); an information floor, not a trained baseline

chance_set_hit_rate.definition: the set-hit rate of a policy that chooses uniformly among the 18 candidates (mean |S| / 18)

initialisation_eval.what: the frozen A0 checkpoint measured on the same 178 A1 states with the same L_set / L_unsafe / set-hit definitions, before any gradient step (this is the starting point of the curve)

smoke_run.note: a 20-step smoke on its own checkpoint directory, run before the real training to prove the GPU path, the checkpoint write and the frozen read-back

checkpoint_reproducibility.reason: the checkpoint payload carries created_at, so a re-run writes a different file sha256 even when the model is identical; the state_dict digest is the identity that matters
checkpoint_reproducibility.determinism_note: the 5,000-step run reproduced its own weights bit-for-bit across two processes on the same GPU under torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
